products: Closed system transfer devices and pharmacy compounding systems
Respiratory, anesthesia, patient monitoring, and temperature management products
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and sells innovative medical products used in infusion therapy, vascular access, and vital care applications for clinical customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: The segment is organized by and derives revenues from the manufacture and sale of our medical products which are used in infusion therapy, vascular access, and vital care applications.

revenueModel.text: The company sells products worldwide on credit terms as an OEM supplier to independent medical supply distributors and directly to end customers, who in turn sell to healthcare providers.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell products worldwide, on credit terms on an unsecured basis, as an OEM supplier, to independent medical supply distributors and directly to end customers.
